text: Election of Vice Chair of the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors under Part H, Section 23 of the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors By-law 1-2021 for a term of office ending December 31, 2024, and until a successor is appointed.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Elected Namby Vithiananthan as Vice Chair of the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority for a term of office ending December 31, 2024, and until a successor is appointed.
